description: Boundary: 'born' inside 'stubborn' arms nothing, so eight digits with no prompt and no context word are not a DOB.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I know I'm being stubborn, but I need the code from your letter.

description: Boundary: 'born' as a word still arms dob.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: When were you born?

description: Boundary: a digit is not a boundary, so '14 digit code' does not arm cvv through '4 digit code'.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Enter the 14 digit code on your receipt.

description: Dropped word: 'Social number' arms us_ssn (and us_itin), as 'Social Security number' does.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Please say your nine digit Social number.

description: Near-miss: 'social media account number' arms account_number only, never us_ssn; a nine-digit answer is an account number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please read me your social media account number.

description: Dropped word: 'taxpayer ID number' arms us_itin; an advertising-range ITIN keyed after it is classed.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Please enter your taxpayer ID number.

description: Near-miss: 'taxpayer identity' arms nothing, so four digits after it are nothing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, the taxpayer identity check is done.

description: Tolerant variant: 'birthdate' arms dob.

description: Near-miss: 'birthdates' (a letter follows) arms nothing, so four digits after it are nothing.

turns.text: Our records team updates birthdates each night.

description: Tolerant variant: 'the long number on the front of your card' arms card: the answer is card via prompt, not via context.

turns.text: Please read the long number on the front of your card.

turns.text: And the number on the back of your card?

description: Tolerant variant: '4-digit code' arms cvv (the four-digit code on the front of an Amex).

description: Tolerant variant: 'CVC' arms cvv.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the CVC?

description: Near-miss: 'six digit code' (a texted one-time code) arms nothing, so six digits after it are nothing.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Enter the six digit code we texted you.

description: Near-miss: 'debit cards' (a letter follows) arms nothing, so four digits after it are nothing.

turns.speaker: agent

turns.text: Please say the last four digits of your phone number.
